name: butterchurn-mcp
description: MilkDrop-style audio-reactive WebGL visualizer via butterchurn. FastMCP 3.4+ server with BPM sync for mixx-dj-mcp.

tools.name: get_bpm
tools.description: Read the current BPM driving the visualizer beat generator.

tools.name: set_bpm
tools.description: Set the BPM (60-200) for visualizer beat sync, e.g. from mixx-dj-mcp.
